title: 第133章 生死都在你手中！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 京兆府尹这个位置很重要，维持整个京都的治安和稳定。但也是最难熬最痛苦的位置。因为在京都贵族豪族遍地走，随便一个案子，都有可能牵扯到世家豪族，牵扯到朝中重臣甚至亲王皇子。到时候要你给面子，这个面子你给不给？给面子，那案子就不可能做到公平公正，受害者无处申冤。不给面子，那京兆府尹的位置，你也别想坐了。甚至，还可能广受牵连。炎文帝一连十几级跳，将他丢到这个位置，要说没一点阴谋，唐逸打死都不相信。唐逸没猜错。炎文帝将他放到这个位置，自然是经过深思熟虑的，他就喜欢唐逸那股劲，那股敢打敢拼的劲。只是现在被这家伙这么直白的问，朕不要面子吗？“别把朕想得那么功利好吗？朕是为你好！”炎文帝背着双手，冷哼一声。唐逸：“呵呵！”炎文帝瞪了唐逸一眼，想了想还是觉得有必要透露一些信息，免得到时候这家伙会措手不及。“京都要乱了，而朕不想京都乱。”“所以，朕需要一个所有人都不熟悉，又不亲近所有人的人来坐这个位置。”唐逸看着炎文帝，很怀疑他说的人是自己？我不亲近所有人？谁说的？那是因为他们先将我当成敌人了。他们要是好好的和我说话，会发现我非常的平易近人好吧！“陛下，你确定你是认真的？”唐逸指着自己，道：“让我来坐这个位置，有没有可能……京都会更乱？”“而且，我怎么觉得你是在借刀杀人？”“我现在是京兆府尹加忠勇侯，朝中无数大臣现在估计都恨不得弄死我。”“你现在将我弄到这个位置，是将我架在火上烤。”“最重要的是以我的脾气，遇到不平的事，我会管，你是嫌我得罪的人不够多？”炎文帝当时都给气乐了，还分析得有理有据，但朕杀你还需要借刀？你也太高看自己了！“说得很对，那就算了，忠勇侯不封了，三品京兆府尹也不给了……”炎文帝看向陈貂寺，道：“传朕旨意，之前对唐逸的封赏，一律……”唐逸嘴角一抽，怎么说不过就威胁人呢？他连忙拦住炎文帝，道：“别别别，君无戏言，说出来的话就是圣旨，陛下怎么能出尔反尔呢？”炎文帝睨着唐逸，义正词严：“朕真没有出尔反尔，朕是真的觉得，你适合一步一个脚印走上来。”“什么忠勇侯，什么京兆府尹，全是狗屁！”“放心，有能力的臣子，从锦衣卫走到忠勇侯，也不会太久，顶多也就五十年吧！”“从百户到从三品的京兆府尹，那更简单了，也就三十年左右。”“没关系，你还年轻，等得起！”唐逸脸皮微僵，呆愕看着炎文帝在那表演。我等得你大爷哦！想什么呢？我会花五十年的时间，去拼你的一个侯爵？何需五十年？信不信我要有野心，给我半年时间准备一下，马上我就可以找个地方称帝，一年后就能募兵三十万，三年就能灭大炎，五年就能灭大炎周边六国？五十年后，说不定太阳所照之处，皆是大炎国土了！但现在的皇帝算得上是个好皇帝，对他和妹妹都极好，这个面子必须得给。他干咳一声，昂首挺胸道：“陛下错了，年轻人最需要的是挑战，遇到困难岂能退缩。”“京兆府尹的位置我接了，陛下放心，有我在，京都乱不了。”“接了？”炎文帝看着唐逸，冷笑：“怎么？现在不怕是朕的阴谋了？”在绝对的实力面前，一切阴谋诡计都是徒劳！阴谋？阴谋在炸弹面前，还不得靠边站？唐逸笑道：“那是陛下对我的历练，我岂能不识好歹呢！”炎文帝看了一眼远处躺在地上已经一动不动得唐敬，挥了挥手，让陈貂寺带人回去劝架，免得真将人给打死了。陈貂寺走后，炎文帝看向唐逸道：“因为兵祸，灾荒以及某些人的特意操控下，如今东南西北都有大量的流民向京都而来。”“综合暗谍和各地锦衣卫的报告，总人数超过十万人。”“十万流民涌进京都，会让本就不堪重负的京都陷入混乱。”“朕能给你拖延半个月，半个月后，就会有流民不断涌进京都。”炎文帝看向唐逸，道：“在这之前，朕要你想好治理流民的对策，确保京都不乱……”说到这里，炎文帝眉心微拧，欲言又止：“此事，还涉及一个隐秘，但这秘密朕暂且不能告诉你，怕你知道了承受不住。”“朕只希望，这个隐秘永远别用上。”唐逸无语，话都说到这份上了，你还给我打哑谜呢？隐秘？什么样的隐秘，能让你一个皇帝忌惮成这样？“还有户部的案子不能拖了，朕现在很需要银子。”炎文帝走近唐逸，道：“这两日放松下，三天后就是大朝，朕期待你在大朝上的表现！”话落，炎文帝便背着双手离开了，御前司已经进来，将整个沈园给包围了，也就意味外面的暗京楼高手，已经被处理得差不多了。皇帝走了，世家大族和满朝文武也在御前司的保护下，陆续离开了沈园。连被打得惨不忍睹的唐敬和颜霜玉等人，也被孔家贴心派人抬了回去。片刻功夫，原本人满为患的鹿鸣湖，就只剩下寥寥数人。唐逸压着绣春刀，看着众人远去的背影，只是淡淡一笑。今日最大的赢家，不是他，而是炎文帝。不仅震慑了满朝文武，还一举将暗京楼这颗毒瘤铲除了，还将他这把剑磨得锋芒毕露，简直赢麻了好吧！“额，我靠，皇帝是不是傻了？”忽地，唐逸想到了什么，一拍脑门道：“那些宣布不再效忠他的大臣，他似乎还没有处置吧？”“这么重要的事？他竟然忘记了？”“不是忘记了，是在等你。”孔诗岚的声音传来。唐逸抬头看去，就看到孔诗岚站在不远处，看他的目光那是相当的复杂。唐逸被她盯得有些莫名其妙，道：“怎么这么看着我？你说等我？又是什么意思？”孔诗岚抿唇一笑，道：“陛下没有现在处置，是等你查出户部的案子，到时候他们如果也牵扯其中，那处置他们的理由将更加充足，届时数罪并罚，轻则抄家流放或满门抄斩，重则就会牵涉九族了。”“所以，三天后的大朝，很多人的生死都在你的手中！”
content_en: The position of Jingzhao Fuyin is very important, maintaining the security and stability of the entire Kyoto.But it is also the most difficult and painful position.Because nobles and wealthy families are everywhere in Kyoto, any case may involve aristocratic families, important officials in the court, or even princes.When the time comes, I need you to give me face. Will you give me this face?If you give face, it will be impossible for the case to be fair and just, and the victim will have nowhere to redress his grievances.If you don't give me face, you won't be able to sit in the position of Jingzhao Prefecture Yin.It may even be widely implicated.Emperor Yanwen jumped more than ten levels in a row to throw him into this position. If he had no conspiracy at all, Tang Yi wouldn't believe it.Tang Yi guessed right.Emperor Yanwen placed him in this position after careful consideration. He liked Tang Yi's energy and his courage to fight.But now I'm being asked so bluntly by this guy, "Don't I want to lose face?""Don't think of me as being so utilitarian, okay? I'm doing this for your own good!" Emperor Yan Wen clasped his hands behind his back and snorted coldly.Tang Yi: "Haha!" Emperor Yan Wen glared at Tang Yi. After thinking about it, he still felt that it was necessary to reveal some information, lest this guy would be caught off guard."The capital is going to be in chaos, and I don't want the capital to be in chaos." "So, I need someone who is unfamiliar to everyone and not close to everyone to sit in this position." Tang Yi looked at Emperor Yan Wen, wondering if the person he was talking about was him?I'm not close to everyone?Who said that?That's because they regarded me as their enemy first.If they talk to me properly, they will find that I am very approachable!"Your Majesty, are you sure you are serious?" Tang Yi pointed at himself and said: "If you let me sit in this position, is it possible that... Kyoto will be even more chaotic?" "And why do I think you are borrowing a knife to kill people?" "I am now the Marquis Yin Jiazhongyong of Jingzhao Prefecture, and countless ministers in the court are probably eager to do so.Kill me." "You put me in this position now to roast me on the fire." "The most important thing is that with my temper, I will take care of injustice.Do you think I have offended not enough people?" Emperor Yanwen was very happy at the time, and his analysis was reasonable, but I still need a knife to kill you?You think too highly of yourself!"That's right. Forget it. I won't give him the title of Marquis Zhongyong, and I won't give him the title of Third-Rank Jingzhao Prefect..." Emperor Yan Wen looked at Chen Diao Temple and said, "It is my will that all the rewards given to Tang Yi before will be..." The corner of Tang Yi's mouth twitched, how could he threaten someone without saying anything?He quickly stopped Emperor Yan Wen and said, "Bye bye bye, you have no joke. What you say is the imperial edict. How could your majesty go back on your word?" Emperor Yanwen looked at Tang Yi and spoke sternly: "I really didn't go back on my word. I really feel that you are suitable to step up step by step." "What Zhongyonghou, what Jingzhao Prefecture Yin, they are all the same.Bullshit!" "Don't worry, it won't take long for a capable minister to go from Jinyiwei to Zhongyonghou, at most fifty years!" "From Baihu to Jingzhao Prefecture of the third grade, it's even easier, it's only about thirty years." "It doesn't matter, you are still young, you can afford to wait!" Tang Yi looked at Emperor Yanwen's performance in a daze.I can't wait for you, uncle!What are you thinking about?Would I spend fifty years fighting to become one of your marquises?Why does it take fifty years?Believe it or not, I have to be ambitious. Give me half a year to prepare. I can find a place to proclaim myself emperor immediately. I can recruit 300,000 troops in one year. I can destroy Great Yan in three years. I can destroy the six surrounding countries of Great Yan in five years?Fifty years from now, maybe wherever the sun shines, it will be the land of Great Yan!But the current emperor is considered a good emperor and treats him and his sister very well. This face must be given.He coughed dryly, held his head high and said, "Your Majesty is wrong. What young people need most is a challenge. How can you shrink back when encountering difficulties." "I have taken over the position of Jingzhao Governor. Your Majesty, don't worry, as long as I am here, there will be no chaos in Kyoto." "Take it?" Emperor Yan Wen looked at Tang Yi and sneered: "What? Are you not afraid of my conspiracy now?" In the face of absolute strength, all conspiracies and tricks are in vain!conspiracy?The conspiracy is in front of the bomb, so why not stand aside?Tang Yi smiled and said, "That's what your Majesty has trained me to do. How can I not know good from evil!" Emperor Yan Wen glanced at Tang Jing, who was lying motionless on the ground in the distance, and waved his hand, asking Chen Diao Si to take people back to break up the fight, so as not to really beat him to death.After Chen Diao Temple left, Emperor Yanwen looked at Tang Yi and said: "Because of war, famine, and the deliberate control of some people, a large number of refugees are now coming to Kyoto from the southeast, northwest, and northwest." "Based on reports from secret spies and Jinyi guards from various places, the total number of people exceeds 100,000." "The influx of 100,000 refugees into Kyoto will plunge the already overwhelmed Kyoto into chaos." "I can delay it for you for half a month. After half a month, refugees will continue to pour into Kyoto." Emperor Yan Wen looked at Tang Yi and said, "Before that, I want you to think of a way to manage the refugees and ensure that there is no chaos in the capital..." At this point, Emperor Yan Wen frowned slightly and hesitated: "This matter also involves another person.It's a secret, but I can't tell you this secret for now, for fear that you won't be able to bear it if you know it." "I just hope that this secret will never be used." Tang Yi was speechless. After all this, you still give me riddles?secret?What kind of secret can make you, an emperor, so afraid?"There are also cases in the Ministry of Finance that cannot be postponed. I need money very much now." Emperor Yanwen approached Tang Yi and said, "Relax for the past two days. The great court will be in three days. I look forward to your performance in the great court!" After saying this, Emperor Yanwen left with his hands behind his back. The Imperial Secretary has come in and surrounded the entire Shen Yuan, which means that the masters of the Anjing Tower outside have been dealt with.After the emperor left, the aristocratic families and the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty also left Shenyuan one after another under the protection of Yuqiansi.Even Tang Jing, Yan Shuangyu and others who were beaten horribly were carried back by the Kong family.In a short time, there were only a few people left in Luming Lake, which was originally crowded.Tang Yi held down Xiuchundao and looked at the retreating figures of everyone, and just smiled faintly.The biggest winner today is not him, but Emperor Yanwen.Not only did he frighten the civil and military officials of the entire dynasty, but he also eradicated the cancer of Anjing Tower in one fell swoop, and sharpened his sword to its sharpest point. It was a win!"Uh, shit, is the emperor stupid?" Suddenly, Tang Yi thought of something, slapped his forehead and said, "It seems that he hasn't dealt with those ministers who announced that they will no longer be loyal to him, right?" "Such an important thing? He actually forgot?" "I didn't forget, I was waiting for you." Kong Shilan's
